message: You know, I always thought I could handle a little heat—after all, I’ve survived family gatherings in July! But it turns out that being prepared for a storm (or a sudden heatwave) is a bit more complicated than just staying indoors with a fan and a cold drink. It’s a good reminder that a little planning goes a long way. So, maybe take a peek at some resources to get yourself ready. After all, we all want to avoid the comedy of NOT being ready. ☀️
